About Us

Built on Trust,
Crafted with Pride

CBR Construction is a Canterbury-based building company led by Lalith Kumara Waduge, a NZCB certified professional builder - committed to delivering exceptional craftsmanship and creating beautiful, enduring homes that blend modern style with lasting quality.

We combine trusted building techniques with modern design principles, working closely with our clients from first consultation through to final handover - because your dream home is our top priority.
